audit_event_seal_check.name: audit_event_seal_check
audit_event_seal_check.value:
("audit_event"."seq" is null and "audit_event"."prev_hash" is null and "audit_event"."hash" is null)
        or ("audit_event"."seq" is not null and "audit_event"."prev_hash" is not null and "audit_event"."hash" is not null)

clinical_note_state_check.name: clinical_note_state_check
clinical_note_state_check.value:
(
        ("clinical_note"."status" = 'draft'
          and "clinical_note"."signed_at" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_reason_enc" is null and "clinical_note"."error_marked_by" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_marked_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_note"."status" = 'signed'
          and "clinical_note"."signed_at" is not null
          and "clinical_note"."draft_content_enc" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_reason_enc" is null and "clinical_note"."error_marked_by" is null
          and "clinical_note"."error_marked_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_note"."status" = 'entered_in_error'
          and "clinical_note"."error_reason_enc" is not null
          and "clinical_note"."error_marked_by" is not null and "clinical_note"."error_marked_at" is not null
          and "clinical_note"."draft_content_enc" is null)
      )

patient_coverage_dates_check.name: patient_coverage_dates_check
patient_coverage_dates_check.value: "patient_coverage"."valid_from" is null or "patient_coverage"."valid_to" is null or "patient_coverage"."valid_to" >= "patient_coverage"."valid_from"

patient_coverage_end_check.name: patient_coverage_end_check
patient_coverage_end_check.value: ("patient_coverage"."ended_at" is null) = ("patient_coverage"."end_reason" is null) and ("patient_coverage"."end_reason" is null or "patient_coverage"."end_reason" in ('replaced', 'removed'))

document_replaces_live_key.name: document_replaces_live_key
document_replaces_live_key.where: "document"."replaces_document_id" is not null and "document"."status" <> 'rejected' and "document"."abandoned_at" is null

document_available_check.name: document_available_check
document_available_check.value: "document"."status" not in ('available', 'hidden') or ("document"."sha256" is not null and "document"."content_type" is not null)

document_hidden_check.name: document_hidden_check
document_hidden_check.value: "document"."status" <> 'hidden' or ("document"."hidden_at" is not null and "document"."hidden_by" is not null and "document"."hidden_reason" is not null)

platform_audit_event_seal_check.name: platform_audit_event_seal_check
platform_audit_event_seal_check.value:
("platform_audit_event"."seq" is null and "platform_audit_event"."prev_hash" is null and "platform_audit_event"."hash" is null)
        or ("platform_audit_event"."seq" is not null and "platform_audit_event"."prev_hash" is not null and "platform_audit_event"."hash" is not null)

patient_representative_contact_check.name: patient_representative_contact_check
patient_representative_contact_check.value: "patient_representative"."phone" is not null or "patient_representative"."email" is not null

patient_rights_request_fulfilled_check.name: patient_rights_request_fulfilled_check
patient_rights_request_fulfilled_check.value: ("patient_rights_request"."status" = 'fulfilled') = ("patient_rights_request"."fulfilled_at" is not null and "patient_rights_request"."fulfilled_by" is not null)

professional_hours_exception_interval_ch.name: professional_hours_exception_interval_check
professional_hours_exception_interval_ch.value:
("professional_hours_exception"."location_id" is null and "professional_hours_exception"."weekday" is null and "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute" is null and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" is null)
        or ("professional_hours_exception"."location_id" is not null and "professional_hours_exception"."weekday" is not null
            and "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute" is not null and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" is not null
            and "professional_hours_exception"."weekday" between 1 and 7 and "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute" >= 0 and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" <= 1440 and "professional_hours_exception"."end_minute" > "professional_hours_exception"."start_minute")

schedule_block_scope_check.name: schedule_block_scope_check
schedule_block_scope_check.value: "schedule_block"."professional_id" is not null or "schedule_block"."location_id" is not null

professional_verified_check.name: professional_verified_check
professional_verified_check.value: "professional"."matricula_status" = 'unverified' or ("professional"."matricula" is not null and "professional"."verified_by_operator" is not null)

worklist_item_resolution_check.name: worklist_item_resolution_check
worklist_item_resolution_check.value:
("worklist_item"."status" = 'open' and "worklist_item"."resolved_at" is null and "worklist_item"."resolved_by" is null)
        or ("worklist_item"."status" <> 'open' and "worklist_item"."resolved_at" is not null and "worklist_item"."resolved_by" is not null)
